items.text: Muhurat trading opening Samvat 2083 ended slightly lower: the Sensex fell 29 points to 80,999 and the Nifty 44 points to 24,986, dragged by banks and IT while pharma gained. Reports call it the first negative Muhurat close since 2017.

Trump told CNN that renewed US strikes on Iran are "highly unlikely" if talks on Tehran's nuclear programme and reopening the Strait of Hormuz make progress, while warning he could still strike. Rubio said the sides are not on the verge of a breakthrough; Iran's foreign minister said mediators have stopped travelling since the US midterms.

Trump said the Task Force Iron Gate blockade of Iran's land supply routes is "in full force and effect"; the Revolutionary Guard dismissed it as wordplay. Washington has not said whether it will use force to stop shipments.

Gulf spillover continues: Iran says two tankers hit mines late Nov 7 and UKMTO reported a tanker fire near Khasab, Oman; a Houthi attack damaged an Aramco building in Riyadh (no casualties reported); a drone halted output at Iraqi Kurdistan's Khor Mor gas field, cutting power to over 70% of the region.

The suspension of Section 301 port fees on China-linked vessels runs out at 11:59 pm ET on Nov 9. USTR proposed on Oct 26 to extend it to Jan 9, 2027 (docket USTR-2026-0694), but no final notice was found in the sources checked for this run; without one, fees would resume Nov 10.
items.notes: Final USTR action not located; recheck. Related watch W-261108-01.

items.text: The Supreme Court's November sitting continues: Nielsen v. Watanabe and Hoffmann v. WBI Energy Transmission are argued Nov 9, and Department of Labor v. Sun Valley Orchards on Nov 10. Nov 11 is a court holiday.
items.outlet: Supreme Court of the United States

items.text: Tusk said nobody plans to ban the Nov 11 Independence March in Warsaw and called reports of a ban disinformation. He urged marchers to avoid aggression and respect police, and asked for counter-demonstrations to be dropped. Organisers say the march goes ahead; Warsaw is banning weapons and pyrotechnics on the day.

The government's maximum fuel prices were set only through Nov 9 (petrol 95 at 6.12 zł, diesel at 7.83 zł). No notice for Nov 10 onward had been found when this run checked. e-petrol forecasts petrol 95 at 5.99–6.15 zł and diesel at 7.71–7.85 zł this week.

National politics is on pause during the two days of national mourning (Nov 8–9). The Constitutional Tribunal dispute, including PSL's 'reset' proposal, was the main issue before the attack; Rzeczpospolita reports that how it resumes is now open.
